candidates.title: “My young life, finished already?”: a qualitative study of embedded social stressors and their effects on mental health of low-wage male migrant workers in Singapore

review.finding: Low-wage migrant workers linked hot, crowded dormitories with poor sleep and fatigue, alongside other stressors on their mental health. It supports the sleep part of the cycle, not the whole loop.
review.limit: Recruited through one support organisation, mainly Indian and Bangladeshi workers; interviews describe experience, not measured sleep.

candidates.title: Impacts of heat on sleep quality among heat-exposed workers: a systematic review
candidates.venue: Annals of Occupational and Environmental Medicine

review.finding: Across 11 studies, heat was linked to poorer sleep among people who work in it. This supports the heat and sleep part of the cycle; few studies follow heat built up over a season.
review.limit: Mostly cross-sectional studies with different measures, so the results were not pooled.
